purpose: Provide transparent sensitivity diagnostics for SCB Cell Key Method perturbation without treating them as statistical confidence intervals or calibration inputs.
requiredChecks: configured CKM cell delta matches model calibration metadata
risk bounds are ordered low <= base <= high for representative event/exposure cells
larger event counts reduce relative impact of a fixed ±3 perturbation
zero/near-zero cells remain finite and nonnegative
2025 CKM diagnostics remain excluded from pre-2025 calibration
UI/method metadata identify CKM as a method break and diagnostics rather than confidence intervals
governance: ±3 is a sensitivity bound tied to the CKM perturbation scale used in this model, not a confidence interval.
CKM diagnostics must not be used to retune historical fertility, mortality or migration parameters.
Any future change in SCB disclosure methodology requires an explicit policy update.
